# Engine conformity

<!-- generated by tools/engine_conformity.py from data_tables/engine_conformity.json; do not edit -->

Engine audit of 2026-10-18 (plan docs/ENGINE_AUDIT.md), verdicts after the fixes. Every mechanic the engine plays was read in the program and held against the engine; the command of an item repeats the reading (`tools/exe_dis.py`). The method of the audit, its phases and its rules are in docs/ENGINE_AUDIT.md.

| Verdict | Items | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| MATCH | 62 | the engine does what the program does |
| FIXED | 32 | the audit found a difference; the engine was corrected (commit named) |
| MODEL-LIMIT | 5 | the engine leaves out a detail on purpose; the note says which, and where it can matter |
| N/A | 0 | not a mechanic of a battle |
| Total | 99 | |
